records.summary: Based on a true story: an 18-year-old music student from Pune, Madhuri, is hypnotised by her school principal (played by Arif Zakaria), who controls students through music. She suddenly loathes music and turns on her parents, going to their room at midnight with a knife; her parents take her to a certified hypnotherapist, whose sessions reveal the principal's hold. Police raid the school, he is arrested and court sends him to a mental asylum.
